title: Structural Validation Outcome
description: Schema defining the structured outcome of structural validation for a runtime contract artifact. Produced by the publisher validation gate at publish time. Not invoked at API request time or during runtime contract loading. The publisher runs jsonschema Draft7Validator against contracts/runtime-contract.schema.json and normalizes errors into the named check IDs and failure categories declared here.
$comment: Normalization rules (D-M4-03-02): schema_version missing → check_id: schema_version_present, failure_category: MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD. schema_version pattern mismatch → check_id: schema_version_format, failure_category: INVALID_SCHEMA_VERSION_FORMAT. features missing → check_id: features_present, failure_category: MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD. features minItems violation → check_id: features_non_empty, failure_category: EMPTY_FEATURES_ARRAY. features[*].name missing or minLength → check_id: feature_name_present, failure_category: MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD. features[*].type missing or enum violation → check_id: feature_type_valid, failure_category: UNKNOWN_FEATURE_TYPE. features[*].domain_constraints if/then/else violation → check_id: domain_constraints_shape, failure_category: INVALID_DOMAIN_CONSTRAINTS_SHAPE (top-level path match takes precedence).

valid.description: Top-level pass/fail indicator. true if all checks passed; false if any check failed.

checks.description: Array of individual check results. One entry per declared structural check. Order is deterministic. When valid is true all checks have passed: true. When valid is false at least one check has passed: false and carries a failure_category.

failure_categories.description: Deduplicated list of all failure_category values from failed checks. Empty array when valid is true. Enables the publisher to programmatically filter outcomes by failure class without iterating the full checks array.

check.description: Result of a single structural check. When passed is false the failure_category field is required and carries a machine-readable failure class. When passed is true the failure_category field must be absent.

check_id.description: Machine-readable identifier for this structural check. Derived from the validation rules in contracts/runtime-contract.schema.json. schema_version_present: schema_version field exists. schema_version_format: schema_version matches ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$. features_present: features field exists. features_non_empty: features has at least one item. feature_name_present: each feature has a non-empty name string. feature_type_valid: each feature type is in [numeric, categorical, boolean]. domain_constraints_shape: domain_constraints shape matches the feature type.

passed.description: true if this check passed; false if it failed.

failure_category.description: Machine-readable failure category for this check. Required when passed is false; must be absent when passed is true. Enables the publisher to reject or log contracts by failure class without parsing free-text error messages.
